training.loss: cross entropy on four option-letter logits

evaluation.temperature_fit: calibration NLL only; 81 logarithmically spaced absolute temperatures from 0.25 to 4
evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired resamples of test query groups, seed 1004
evaluation.promotion: none; report both gains and regressions

split_method: SHA256 deterministic selection; normalized queries do not overlap. Test uses official test only; calibration and additional training use official train. Training is class-balanced; evaluation is hash-selected up to 8 pairs per selected query. Exact query-product prompts cannot overlap. Product identity overlap is measured, not excluded.
demo_selection: First 8 selected test query groups by seeded hash, chosen before model predictions. Recorded mode exposes all held-out examples; optional local live scoring uses the same two model versions and a frozen catalog.
limitations: JevK5 publisher declares 1186 ESCI training examples already used; this tests additional specialization.
Pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out.
English US subset, bounded product text, one training seed and recipe.
No live prices, inventory, web shopping, checkout, or purchases.
